provenance_scope: Recovered descriptive reproduction metadata, not a newly inferred runtime rule

timing.ttft: host call to first non-draft streamer emission
timing.cuda_synchronization: immediately before start and after generate_token_ids
timing.warmup: one model.generate on This is a warmup prompt; 10 tokens; do_sample=False; per worker session

confidence_adjustment_description: base threshold .55; +step on bad streak; +.5*step during cooldown; -.5*step for good streak>=2; clip to configured min/max. Low draft confidence stops after configured token threshold.
